risk_name: AI labor displacement and decision opacity
description: Automation concentrates risk among workers and people subject to opaque decisions.
Transition costs can burden households and extractive regions if poorly governed.
Biotechnology can create access consent and biosecurity inequalities.
Distributed infrastructure can deepen exclusion if access and interoperability fail.
Material innovation can shift ecological and labor burdens to extraction sites.
Care robotics can intensify work and surveillance without worker-centered governance.
Environmental data can support accountability or enable uneven surveillance.
Security transition may leave under-resourced institutions behind.
